newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND PRESIDENT TO QUIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORUSSIA DORTMUND PRESIDENT TO QUIT.

text.p: Gerd Niebaum, president of European Cup winners Borussia Dortmund, said on Tuesday he planned to step down.
Niebaum said he would not be seeking re-election as president at the club's annual meeting this autumn because of excessive burdens related to the position.
"I wouldn't have arrived at this decision had we not won the final last Wednesday. But now I'm leaving the house in order," said Niebaum, who has led Dortmund for the past 11 years.
Niebaum was club president for Dortmund's 1989 German Cup final victory and 1995 and 1996 German championships.
Before that he was part of the board management team who saved the club from possible bankruptcy between 1984 and 1986.
